newsitem.title: JAPAN: RESEARCH ALERT - Hitachi Construction rated. [CORRECTED 03:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hitachi Construction rated. [CORRECTED 03:25 GMT]

text.p: Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics Inc said on Thursday it has kept a "1" rating on Hitachi Construction Machinery Co Ltd.
Yamaichi had earlier mistakenly announced that it had assigned a "2" rating on the company, and corrected the statement to say the rating was being held at "1".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving more than 10 percentage points in either direction of the Tokyo Stock Exchange first-section TOPIX index over the next six months.
